strings.en: Ugh...
Shiro.
...Ngh, ugh... Zeon...
Shiro... hang on, Shiro.
A-Ai...na? Where are we?
We were swept quite far northwest of the base.
All the way to these snowy mountains...
Huh... my hands...?
Your hands have frostbite. Don't push yourself...
If only we could boil water... and warm them slowly...
I... see. The MS is wrecked too. What do we... do now?
I sent a distress signal from the Apsaras as well...
It's on an open channel... so the Gandor Team should pick it up...
Thanks... Aina.
We were just fighting... now we can't survive without joining forces...
Yeah. ...Oh, there's something I need your help with.
Huh?
...That is all. It is definitely the Apsaras.
Understood. ...Lord Ginias, I'll resume the search for Lady Aina.
...I see... so the Apsaras... still has room for improvement...
Ngh... Excuse me, sir!
(Unbelievable... this is hopeless...)
...Do it! ...Ugh! Whew, that's powerful even at minimum output...
Boiling water with a beam weapon... You still think of the strangest things.
Never thought I'd use a Beam Saber for anything but cutting enemies...
but it works.
Shiro, your hands, quickly...
Yeah. ...Oof, my hands are all prickly.
Bear with it. It means your circulation is coming back.
Crouching like this, my legs are going numb...
Hey, wanna... take a bath?
What, a distress signal!?
On an open channel! It's Zeon's, but... maybe...
We can't just ignore it. What do we do, Commander?
I'll take the Bluegar out. For this kinda thing, you need something nimble.
Right, Mister. Commander Hazuki, the Copelander is launching.
...True, we can't go flying around in the Gandor...
I'm counting on you, Jinguji.
If only the two of us... were the last man and woman left in this world...
What's that...? Shiro, a Luggun's coming. Please hide.
Aina... we'll meet again, right...?
Yes, surely...
Lieutenant Amada... got a minute?
Captain Amuro...!? ...I'm sorry for acting on my own.
I didn't come to blame you for that. It's just...
Just?
...I, and Kamille too...
once lost our hearts to a Zeon pilot.
How it ended... I'll leave to your imagination. But be prepared.
This is... war.
Sorry... I intruded.
...Aina... but I...!
Shiro?
...Hm, Kiki? What's up?
Well, two guys making sad faces together...
got my maternal instincts going.
Sorry, Kiki. Right... brooding won't get me anywhere...
I just have to fight my own way. ...Until this war is over...!
That's it. What's good about you is that ridiculously positive streak.
...I like you that way, Shiro.
...Thanks, Kiki.
(Master... why...?)
Hey, Domon.
...Hm? Oh... it's you two...
Don't "oh" us. We came all this way to cheer you up.
I don't need cheering up.
You were thinking about Master Asia... weren't you?
Hey, spar with me, Domon. Moving around'll clear your head.
I'm not in the mood.
...Martial artists can only express their hearts with their fists, right?
Then strike Master Asia with your fists and tell him how you feel!
I hate it when you mope like this, Domon.
Rain...
That's right!
If you talk with your fists, I'm sure your master will understand.
(Talk... with my fists, huh...)
Come on, let's train. We've gotta get stronger.
If you keep sulking, I'm never speaking to you again.
Heh, all right, you two.
Hey! Enough already! Show, say something to them!
All right. Everyone, Cham isn't a sideshow. So...
Aww, come on, Show, it's fine!
That's right! Cham, come over here!
A fairy... how romantic.
Like I said, I'm a Mi Ferario!
She's a real hit, ain't she.
Some crew they stuck us in. Super robots that were big heroes before,
alien mechs, and now a fairy. Won't get bored, that's for sure.
I'd like a little boredom. ...Meganoids reviving, the Campbellians invading...
We can't afford to be too optimistic.
Banjo's right, Hyoma. Ain't ye gettin' a bit too relaxed?
That's right. The enemies that came with the Campbellians...
they're still unidentified, you know?
...I know that, all right?
But Kosuke, all we can do now is fight like crazy, right?
Aoi has a point. Until we see the whole picture... we just keep struggling.
Banjo, come to think of it, didn't you beat the Meganoids?
Ain't that strange?
Yeah, I think so too. Most likely... something happened on Mars.
Nooo, don't pull my wings!
Ufufu, she's just too cute!
...All you can do is run until they get bored, Cham.
Show! No way!
Beauty, Reika! I'm going to contact Garrison.
Don't be too rough with that little lady!
Show! Is Show Zama here?
Hm? Yes?
...The Aura Battler pilot we took in... is awake.
...Todd? Got it, I'll be right there. Cham, I'm going to the infirmary!
Hey, Shoooow! Help me before you go!
I see. So that's what happened...
By the time we reached that area, the Federation battleship Crocus
that went ahead was nowhere to be seen. It's still missing.
So then, from the Tulip that apparently swallowed the Crocus,
Yurika's Nadesico suddenly appeared?
Yes.
We came out right in the middle of a battle zone, so it was such a shock!
Tulips... for now they're thought to be a kind of wormhole,
but you're saying the Nadesico warped here from Mars...
Anyway... Yuuuurikaaa! I'm so glad you came back safe~
Daddy was so worried, so worried...
Oh, Father! There, there, don't cry. Everyone's watching.
...Sigh.
Ahem. ...That warp system... the Boson Jump...
still holds many mysteries the Federation hasn't solved,
but the Nadesico's jump data this time may tell us something.
Hey! Is it true the Nadesico came back from Mars!?
Yes~ We're back~
Joe! You can't just barge into a meeting!
It's fine now. We've covered most of it.
So? What about retaking Mars!? What happened to the settlement!?
Um, well, that's...
Joe, I'm afraid the Scaparelli Project...
was a failure.
A failure?
Then what about our parents at the settlement?
I'm afraid nothing has changed.
I got my hopes up hearing there was a ship heading to retake Mars...
I don't think you need to worry so much about the settlement.
What do you mean?
Rumor has it Commander Hazard is in league with Za Boom and Meganoids,
and teaming up with the invaders has, in the end,
kept the Martian citizens safe, you see.
So what? You're saying Hazard's in bed with the invaders
to protect Mars's citizens!? That sly old fox!?
I won't go that far, but joining hands to avoid invasion
is a common enough story.
But knowing an ambitious man like Hazard, I doubt that's all...
Before heading to Nergal's research facility at the Martian polar cap,
we called the settlement, but Commander Hazard said it
was fine and told us to head for the polar cap first...
Well... he did seem to be hiding something.
Of course, the Federation has no intention of leaving Mars like this.
Tch, looks like retaking Mars is still a long way off.
Oh, and Hazuki, there's one thing I forgot to mention.
What is it?
Yurika's Nadesico will be under Londo Bell's command for a while.
You mean it's been assigned to the Federation Forces?
No, not exactly, but at Nergal's offer,
we'll be forming a joint front.
Right now we need every hand we can get.
I'll entrust the Nadesico to Bright and have them defend space.
Understood.
Then I look forward to your efforts. That is all.
Very well.
Roger.
And Yurika.
Yes?
If anything happens, come right back, okay? Daddy loves you more than...
...Admiral.
Oh? Ah, yes, sorry, sorry.
...Geez, how embarrassing.
Runs in the family...?
No doubt about it.
There, all done.
Thanks, miss.
Todd!
...Show. Never thought you'd be the one to save me.
Todd... what happened in Byston Well!?
You and me are enemies...
I'm grateful you helped, but I've got no reason to help my enemy out.
Is this really the time for that, Todd...!
Our real home... the surface here is in danger.
...What? You mean it's tied to the one that tossed me out of Byston Well...
that plant bastard?
I don't know.
But one thing's for sure: this isn't the time for us to fight each other.
...You want me to work with you? Show?
...Extra firepower couldn't hurt.
You really think I'll side with you? You've gotten naive, Show.
...Fine, whatever.
But get this: it's to protect my mom in Boston. Don't get the wrong idea.
Thanks, Todd.
You didn't need to come along, you know.
Am I a bother?
Yes...
So, how is it?
This footage is of Akito Tenkawa the moment he Boson Jumped from Mars...
That's from when the Nadesico came out of the Tulip, right?
Look...
Well, well...
Heh... he's... nice...
Who are these? The ones from New York...? Why are they together...
You want me to cooperate? Who are these...!
Collaborators? Then their aim is...!
Very well... if you say so, I'll make good use of them...
for my own grand purpose...
Right, we'll soon reach our destination, Jaburo...
We're finally gonna find out what's going on at Jaburo.
At last, we'll see Jaburo's current state with our own eyes.
So far, no unusual readings, but...
Kamille, we just passed the facility you were at, right?
Yeah. As you can see, nothing looks odd from the air, does it?
The HQ facility is a bit farther on, underground...
If the attack came from underground, no wonder Bidan didn't notice.
Even this close, still no contact... It's strange.
Indeed...
The recon unit Admiral Misumaru sent has apparently vanished as well.
If the Admiral's unit has vanished...
there's a good chance the enemy is still here...
It's about time.
Commander! Radar contact!
Identify!?
The Einst... the enemy that appeared in New York!
Those bone-and-plant things...
All right, all hands, battle stations. Stay alert!
...The Einst... Einst, huh.
